job_description:
Elementary School Teacher

Our school is seeking a certified Elementary School Teacher.

Responsibilities
- Develop lesson plans aligned to state curriculum standards
- Teach and instruct students across reading, math and science
- Maintain positive classroom management
- Use differentiated instruction to support ESL and special education students (IEP)
- Conduct student assessment and track progress; communicate with parents

Requirements
- Must have: Teaching experience
- Lesson Planning and Classroom Management skills
- Bachelor's degree in Education; teaching certification required
- 2+ years of teaching experience preferred
